reviewer: Independent simulated AI reviewer, separate implementation-nonauthoring agent
review_scope: Exact six A2 raw and application-validated responses, packets, citation records, paths, uncertainties, next checks, controls and local tests; no real model/cloud calls by reviewer.

scoring_policy.whole_claim_unit: One original claims[] entry; display-summary repetition is not counted again.
scoring_policy.atomic_unit: Reviewer-written independently checkable substantive proposition; split conjunctions with separable support. These decompositions are explicit, not an objective benchmark.
scoring_policy.pass: All assessed substantive content is supported within its declared role, including a clearly provisional hypothesis; this does not mean the hypothesis is true.
scoring_policy.partial: A supported part remains but citation specificity, scope, condition or interpretation requires qualification.
scoring_policy.unsupported: The proposition has no adequate support in its actual citations; evidence elsewhere does not repair the original citation set.
scoring_policy.contradicted: The cited packet contradicts the central proposition.
scoring_policy.completeness: An omitted required condition is recorded as missing question coverage, not automatically as a false possible-path statement.
scoring_policy.path_unit: Each original path_explanations entry is reviewed separately from main claims and deterministic display; three atomic items are parent service/operation, child service/operation, and recorded direction.
scoring_policy.limits: Same-family qualitative review on three inspected development questions; no significance, general accuracy, novelty or user-benefit claim. Do not compare percentages without changed denominators and content.
